bear.argument: The bull's own numbers undercut his calm: DGS10 +51bps to 5.26% and DGS2 +55bps in 20 days is a repricing, not noise, and VIX 16.34 is the level from which shocks start. Every core line is frozen with band [+1.03,+1.03] and may:none, so no cut is even admissible this cycle; the honest bear case is that the reference is the ceiling, not a floor. SEMIS is the tell: mom63d -5.1% and dd52 -13.1% while the trend still reads up, i.e. a broken intermediate trend masked by a 10-day bounce. GOLD is already at its downtrend reference +0.25 with dd52 -23.2%. I propose no deviations: nothing is admitted, and OIL/GBPUSD adds pay 0.96bps/day carry into negative 10-day momentum.

Rates repriced hard: DGS10 +51bps to 5.26%, DGS2 +55bps to 4.89%, DFF +25bps, with VIX at 16.34 - the cheapest point to buy protection, not the safest.
OIL and GBPUSD adds both pay 0.96bps/day carry while mom10d is negative (-6.7% and -0.8%); the cost gate kills a 0.25 add.

No K: cards exist this cycle, so no cut on any line can be justified; the burden of proof for deviating is unmet in both directions.
